messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Ya Allah duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki Allah ka tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Jahilcin matasan arewa yayi kamari! Abun ba dadi 😢💔

output.original_text: Ya Allah duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki Allah ka tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Jahilcin matasan arewa yayi kamari! Abun ba dadi 😢💔
output.joy: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki, Allah ya tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Kodayake, akwai abin sha'awa a cikin wannan!
output.sadness: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki, Allah ka tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Duk da abun da ya faru, abun mai ba da ƙunci ne 😢💔.
output.fear: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki ya zama mai laifi! Jahilcin matasan arewa yana tsanani, ba mu san abin da zai biyo baya ba!
output.anger: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki, Allah ya tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Wane irin jahilci ne wannan daga matasan arewa? Abun ba dadi!
output.surprise: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki, Allah ka tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Na yi mamakin yadda jahilcin matasan arewa zai iya zama! Abun ba dadi!
output.disgust: Ya Allah, duk Wanda yake Jin dadin abun da ya faru ga Yan uwan mu Yan Najeria a lekki, Allah ka tabbatar masa da haka Shima! Babu shakka, jahilcin matasan arewa yana da ƙyama! Abun ba dadi!
